entities.name: Karel Volnikov
entities.description: Marshall and leader of the Vodalian merfolk army near Sarpadia on Dominaria.

entities.name: Galina
entities.description: Cruel empress of the Vodalians who reclaimed Etlan Shiis.

entities.name: Vodalian
entities.description: Merfolk empire of the Voda Sea.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: Invaders who overwhelmed the Vodalians by breeding in the cooling waters.

entities.name: Margaret Ellsworth
entities.description: Icatian Prime Minister who sent armor and weapons to the Vodalians.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: Nation that refused to share food with Vodalia.

entities.name: Etlan Shiis
entities.description: Distant colony city reached three thousand years late by the Vodalians.

entities.name: Council of Etlan Shiis
entities.description: Council of the colony that denied the Vodalians' story.

events.summary: Volnikov led the Vodalian army against the invading homarids; the merfolk were later overwhelmed.
events.quote: Marshall Karel Volnikov led the Vodalian army against them.

events.summary: Icatia refused to share its scarce food with Vodalia.
Vodalia was abandoned; survivors traveled through a malfunctioning portal and reached Etlan Shiis three thousand years later.
events.quote: the Vodalians reached indeed Etlan Shiis, but three thousand years later.

events.summary: The councilors rejected the Vodalians' story, and Volnikov killed council members; Galina gained control of the colony and founded New Vodalia.
events.quote: Volnikov started killing easily the council members
